aim_summary.goal: Add editor-defined patterns of cylindrical holes to the lower and upper support platforms to reduce their weight.
preserve_targets: all non-targeted model geometry and the red platforms' geometry outside the added holes
aim_summary.expected_outcome: Both support platforms contain more cylindrical holes than before, with an editor-selected pattern amount, reducing platform mass and weight while preserving unrelated geometry and interfaces.

operations_plan.summary: Create additional cylindrical hole patterns in the lower and upper support platform bodies.

steps.description: Create the editor-defined additional cylindrical hole pattern on the lower platform support face.
Create the editor-defined additional cylindrical hole pattern on the upper platform support face.

expected_result.geometry: The lower and upper support platforms contain a greater amount of cylindrical holes than before, arranged in the number of patterns selected by the editor.
expected_result.function: The additional holes provide weight reduction for both support platforms.
expected_result.behavior: Additional removed material lowers the mass and gravitational weight of both platforms.

validation_criteria.description: Cylindrical holes exist in both support platforms.
The final cylindrical-hole amount in the support platforms is greater than the pre-edit amount.
The final number of hole patterns matches the amount selected by the editor.
The added holes provide weight reduction for the support platforms.
The additional removed volume results in lower platform mass and weight than before.
The guide slots, fixed pivot holes, platform interfaces, and all non-targeted geometry remain unchanged.
